title: The First Big Stone
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler who notices every kind of feeling, and tonight the people sang and wept at once over the temple's first stones: Willow sees Grandma's happy tears at her birthday, climbs up for a hug and tells her they are okay.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because she notices every kind of feeling. In Willow’s world today: at Grandma’s birthday, Willow saw Grandma cry — but they were happy tears! Instead of feeling worried, Willow climbed up for a hug and said, “Your happy tears are okay, Grandma.” Just like the people who laughed and cried while they praised Heavenly Father, Willow learned that joy and tears can live in the very same heart.
